deltas.proposed_change: Insert a typed physical VisionFeatureTap directly at the libmtmd media-embedding boundary. One mtmd encode produces a version/provenance-bound media embedding buffer; a bounded descriptor/MVC readout may inspect it; if escalation is required, the same encoded buffer is passed to decoder processing without a second vision encode. The tap is implementation plumbing, not a new semantic organ and not truth authority.
deltas.expected_benefit: Makes the QNDRF one-encode reuse claim executable and measurable; enables MVC decoder bypass without a duplicate deep visual encoder when raw/projected Qwen features are adequate.
deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: Raw mmproj features are unsuitable for calibrated familiarity/open-set routing or tap/copy/synchronization overhead negates reuse; a dedicated lightweight embedding path remains Pareto-superior.
deltas.discriminating_test: Matched FULL_QWEN vs QNDRF_TAP_RAW vs QNDRF_TAP_PROJECTED vs dedicated-light-embedding baseline with an encode-invocation counter, equal visual fixtures, same action tasks, open-set/OOD controls and full latency/resource metadata.
deltas.rollback: Disable VisionFeatureTap/MVC bypass and return to ordinary libmtmd encode->decode path; no canonical semantic state depends on tap-only data.
deltas.promotion_gate: No promotion before target-VPS matched runtime stability, feature geometry, open-set, action success, recovery and resource receipts.

deltas.proposed_change: Add a pre-promotion scale gate comparing Qwen3.5 0.8B/2B/4B separately for vision-encode-only and decoder-inclusive cost. Do not infer perception cost from total parameter count.
deltas.expected_benefit: Prevents selecting 2B as a presumed cheap visual core when its vision tower is architecturally almost the same as 4B, and exposes whether 0.8B offers a materially cheaper deep-vision regime on the target VPS.
deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: Quality loss or backend overhead makes 0.8B noncompetitive; 2B/4B end-to-end behavior may still dominate despite similar vision tower geometry.
deltas.discriminating_test: Fixed-token encode-only and full visual task matrix on target VPS with 0.8B/2B/4B, then Pareto selection using task correctness, open-set, latency, RSS, CPU, recovery and visual-token cost.
deltas.rollback: Retain current 4B candidate and treat smaller sizes as negative-result baselines.
deltas.promotion_gate: Measured Pareto superiority only; official benchmark rank or size is insufficient.

deltas.proposed_change: Require a multimodal runtime sanity gate before any feature-quality or memory experiment: freeze and verify llama.cpp build, model/mmproj hashes and runtime flags; execute known-image correctness, encode stability, crash/restart and resource checks.
deltas.expected_benefit: Separates model/feature errors from runtime/backend failures already observed in current llama.cpp issue ecology.
deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: Selected target-VPS CPU lane is stable enough that the gate adds little information.
deltas.discriminating_test: Repeat fixed visual fixtures across relevant build/flag variants; if results are invariant and stable, collapse the gate to one verified configuration.
deltas.rollback: Gate remains diagnostic-only and can be narrowed after stable evidence.
